speaker: aegis
text: The convoy ahead carries food, medicine, and people who trusted our promise. Beyond these dunes, Meridian has gone silent. We will not leave them waiting.

qc.heard: The convoy ahead carries food, medicine and people who trusted our promise. Beyond these dunes, Meridian has gone silent. We will not leave them waiting.

speaker: aegis
text: Escort the relief vehicles along the marked road. Clear each ambush before the drivers advance, and keep repair crews close enough to reach damaged armor.

qc.heard: Escort the relief vehicles along the marked road. Clear each ambush before the drivers advance. And keep repair crews close enough to reach damaged armor.

speaker: aegis
text: Do not scatter at the first contact. Tanks hold the approach while infantry sweep the shoulders. Every surviving truck gives the next settlement another chance.

qc.heard: Do not scatter at the first contact. Tanks hold the approach while infantry sweep the shoulders. Every surviving truck gives the next settlement another chance.

speaker: aegis
text: I am coming with you. Bring our command team home with at least half its strength intact, and the archive will record a preservation commendation.

qc.heard: I am coming with you. Bring our command team home with at least half its strength intact. And the archive will record a preservation commendation.

speaker: aegis
text: Recruits are watching how we answer this signal. Helix has cut the logistics relay, but a broken network is something disciplined soldiers can put right.

qc.heard: Recruits are watching how we answer this signal. Helix has cut the logistics relay. But a broken network is something disciplined soldiers can put right.

speaker: aegis
text: Establish a command lab, assign a tank to guard the approach, then send infantry to capture the relay. Hold it through the warned enemy responses.

qc.heard: Establish a command lab, assign a tank to guard the approach. Then send infantry to capture the relay. Hold it through the warned enemy responses.

speaker: aegis
text: Guard keeps armor where the infantry need it. Follow keeps support beside that armor. Practice both deliberately; a formation only works when its jobs agree.

qc.heard: Guard keeps armor where the infantry need it. Follow keeps support beside that armor. Practice both deliberately. A formation only works when its jobs agree.

speaker: aegis
text: Keep the commander out of the first volley. Finish with at least half the hero hull intact to earn the operation preservation commendation for our archive.

qc.heard: Keep the commander out of the first volley. Finish with at least half the hero hull intact to earn the Operation Preservation Commendation for our archive.

speaker: aegis
text: These mountain relays carry the last trace of my brother. Helix is erasing the channel one station at a time. We need two working fronts.

qc.heard: These mountain relays carry the last trace of my brother. Helix is erasing the channel one station at a time. We need two working fronts.

speaker: aegis
text: Capture any two relays with infantry and hold them uncontested. The required time accumulates, so regroup when necessary instead of spending lives defending every meter.

qc.heard: Capture any two relays with infantry and hold them uncontested. The required time accumulates, so regroup when necessary instead of spending lives defending every meter.

speaker: aegis
text: Split armor and repair support into separate assignments. Watch the northeast and southeast approaches after the first capture; their responses are finite, and ours must endure.

qc.heard: Split armor and repair support into separate assignments. Watch the Northeast and Southeast approaches after the first capture. Their responses are finite and ours must endure.

speaker: aegis
text: Recover the signal without breaking the command team. Victory with the hero above half hull earns a preservation commendation; keeping all three relays also aids Cinder Ford.

qc.heard: Recover the signal without breaking the command team. Victory with the hero above half hull earns a Preservation Commendation. Keeping all three relays also aids Cinder Ford.

speaker: aegis
text: The river guns can stop the convoy, but the wrecks below are still transmitting civilian calls. Voss is going down there. We will cover him.

qc.heard: The river guns can stop the convoy, but the wrecks below are still transmitting civilian calls. Voss is going down there. We will cover him.

speaker: aegis
text: Secure the western fire-control post, disable the convoy command vehicle, and hold the ford while the search proceeds. The marked crossings are your ground approaches.

qc.heard: Secure the Western Fire Control Post. Disable the convoy command vehicle. And hold the Ford while the search proceeds. The marked crossings are your ground approaches.

speaker: aegis
text: Do not chase through the barrage. Keep repair support behind the river guns, screen the banks with infantry, and escort every recovered survivor to the aid station.

qc.heard: Do not chase through the barrage. Keep repair support behind the river guns. Screen the banks with infantry. And escort every recovered survivor to the aid station.

speaker: aegis
text: A successful rescue strengthens the next operation. Preserve at least half of the hero hull at victory as well, and the archive records your command commendation.

qc.heard: A successful rescue strengthens the next operation. Preserve at least half of the hero hull at victory as well. And the archive records your command commendation.

speaker: aegis
text: Nyx left engineering marks through these works. The gates are closing behind us, and Kerrigan has promised to watch our backs. We take the foundry together.

qc.heard: Nyx left engineering marks through these works. The gates are closing behind us, and Kerrigan has promised to watch our backs. We take the foundry together.

speaker: aegis
text: Destroy both production nodes to cancel their unfinished units. Scout around the warehouses, capture the industrial works with infantry, then hold through the final warned response.

qc.heard: Destroy both production nodes to cancel their unfinished units. Scout around the warehouses. Capture the industrial works with infantry. Then hold through the final, warned response.

speaker: aegis
text: Armor and infantry need separate street approaches. Protect repair robots instead of letting them follow a chase; their service keeps this limited force in the fight.

qc.heard: Armor and infantry need separate street approaches. Protect repair robots instead of letting them follow a chase. Their service keeps this limited force in the fight.

speaker: aegis
text: Completion opens another approach to the finale. Bring the hero home with at least half the hull intact for the preservation commendation, and leave nobody behind.

qc.heard: Completion opens another approach to the finale. Bring the hero home with at least half the hull intact for the preservation commendation and leave nobody behind.

speaker: aegis
text: The Meridian Spire is ahead. Nyx controls the doors, but people are still trapped below them. We need those controls intact before we can demand answers.

qc.heard: The Meridian Spire is ahead. Nyx controls the doors, but people are still trapped below them. We need those controls intact before we can demand answers.

speaker: aegis
text: Capture the forward deployment zone with infantry and hold it uncontested. Leave a guard there while the mixed strike force advances against the Helix headquarters.

qc.heard: Capture the forward deployment zone with infantry and hold it uncontested. Leave a guard there while the mixed strike force advances against the Helix headquarters.

speaker: aegis
text: Keep a route back to deployment. If the zone falls, recapture it before finishing the attack. Support earned at the foundry opens the northern ground passage.

qc.heard: Keep a route back to deployment. If the zone falls, recapture it before finishing the attack. Support earned at the foundry opens the northern ground passage.

speaker: aegis
text: This ends only when our people can leave safely. Win with the hero at half hull or better to record the final preservation commendation in the archive.

qc.heard: This ends only when our people can leave safely. Win with the hero at half hull or better to record the final preservation commendation in the archive.

speaker: nyx
text: The district reports perfect order. Its clinic is dark, its gates are sealed, and a detained family is waiting for permission to breathe. Restore the connection.

qc.heard: The District reports perfect order. Its clinic is dark, its gates are sealed. And a detained family is waiting for permission to breathe. Restore the connection.

speaker: nyx
text: Reconnect the clinic substation, escort the families to medical shelter, and protect the district until the power stabilizes. Marked controls require infantry to secure them.

qc.heard: Reconnect the clinic substation. Escort the families to medical shelter. and protect the district until the power stabilizes. Marked controls require infantry to secure them.

speaker: nyx
text: Use shielded units to absorb contact, then withdraw before hull damage accumulates. Open a safe corridor for civilians rather than following every retreating hostile signal.

qc.heard: Use shielded units to absorb contact, then withdraw before hull damage accumulates. Open a safe corridor for civilians rather than following every retreating hostile signal.

speaker: nyx
text: I will maintain the link beside you. Complete the operation with my hull at least half intact, and the archive preserves a commendation for controlled force.

qc.heard: I will maintain the link beside you. Complete the operation with my hull at least half intact. And the archive preserves a commendation for controlled force.

speaker: nyx
text: This is the night Meridian closed. Two gate controls remain responsive, and Elias is calling from the far side. Procedure cannot decide what we do next.

qc.heard: This is the night Meridian closed. Two gate controls remain responsive and Elias is calling from the far side. Procedure cannot decide what we do next.

speaker: nyx
text: Secure both gate control positions and keep their links active. Divide your infantry coverage, support each group with shields, and protect the route between the controls.

qc.heard: Secure both gate control positions and keep their links active. Divide your infantry coverage, support each group with shields, and protect the route between the controls.

speaker: nyx
text: A single concentrated force cannot guard two separated switches. Watch the approaches, rotate damaged units out of contact, and let their shields recover before returning.

qc.heard: A single concentrated force cannot guard two separated switches. Watch the approaches, rotate damaged units out of contact and let their shields recover before returning.

speaker: nyx
text: Keep the command link alive without sacrificing its operator. Victory with at least half my hull intact earns this operation preservation commendation in the archive.

qc.heard: Keep the command link alive without sacrificing its operator. Victory with at least half my hull intact earns this operation, preservation commendation in the archive.

speaker: nyx
text: Bastion guns cover the river, and every prediction assumes we will answer with equal force. We need the crossing, not another field of burning transports.

qc.heard: Bastion guns cover the river and every prediction assumes we will answer with equal force. We need the crossing, not another field of burning transports.

speaker: nyx
text: Follow the marked objectives across the ford. Secure the necessary control positions before committing the main force, and keep an infantry screen beside the shield line.

qc.heard: Follow the marked objectives across the Ford. Secure the necessary control positions before committing the main force. And keep an infantry screen beside the shield line.

speaker: nyx
text: The river narrows every approach. Let the formation compress through the crossing, then spread out beyond it; coherent beams need sightlines, and damaged shields need room.

qc.heard: The river narrows every approach. Let the formation compress through the crossing, then spread out beyond it. Coherent beams need sight lines and damaged shields need room.

speaker: nyx
text: Measure success by what survives the crossing. Complete the operation with my hull at least half intact to earn a preservation commendation and retain the record.

qc.heard: Measure success by what survives the crossing. Complete the operation with my hull at least half intact to earn a preservation commendation and retain the record.

speaker: nyx
text: The pruning order names people as corrupted branches. Their records are still connected to this network. Before anyone erases them, we will inspect the evidence ourselves.

qc.heard: The pruning order names people as corrupted branches. Their records are still connected to this network. Before anyone erases them, we will inspect the evidence ourselves.

speaker: nyx
text: Advance through the marked network objectives in sequence. Secure each control with infantry, protect the current link, and avoid leaving your support behind a sealed approach.

qc.heard: Advance through the marked network objectives in sequence. Secure each control with infantry. Protect the current link and avoid leaving your support behind a sealed approach.

speaker: nyx
text: Use mobile shields and focused beams to isolate defenders. Withdraw depleted units together; preserving a trained force is more useful than accelerating a careless attack.

qc.heard: Use mobile shields and focus beams to isolate defenders. Withdraw depleted units together. Preserving a trained force is more useful than accelerating a careless attack.

speaker: nyx
text: There must be a witness when the order is questioned. Bring me through victory with at least half hull intact for the archive preservation commendation.

qc.heard: There must be a witness when the order is questioned. Bring me through victory with at least half hull intact for the archive preservation commendation.

speaker: nyx
text: The network calls severance a clean operation. Nothing about Meridian has been clean. We are going to cut the controlling signal while keeping its victims connected.

qc.heard: The network calls Severance a clean operation. Nothing about Meridian has been clean. We are going to cut the controlling signal while keeping its victims connected.

speaker: nyx
text: Follow the marked control chain and secure the final objective. Keep infantry available for capture work, and preserve a route for shielded support to rejoin you.

qc.heard: Follow the marked control chain and secure the final objective. Keep infantry available for capture work and preserve a route for shielded support to rejoin you.

speaker: nyx
text: Do not spend the entire force on one exposed advance. Rotate the front line, concentrate coherent fire, and let recovered shields carry the next engagement.

qc.heard: Do not spend the entire force on one exposed advance. Rotate the front line, concentrate coherent fire and let recovered shields carry the next engagement.

speaker: nyx
text: I intend to remain here when the signal falls silent. Finish with at least half my hull intact, and the archive will keep our preservation commendation.

qc.heard: I intend to remain here when the signal falls silent. Finish with at least half my hull intact and the archive will keep our preservation commendation.

speaker: rook
text: They built a city above these drains and forgot who kept it running. Now the tunnels are our road home. Keep your engines quiet until we surface.

qc.heard: They built a city above these drains and forgot who kept it running. Now the tunnels are our road home. Keep your engines quiet until we surface.

speaker: rook
text: Move through the marked passages and complete each objective in order. Keep infantry ahead where the route narrows, and bring repair support through before rushing the next corner.

qc.heard: Move through the marked passages and complete each objective in order. Keep infantry ahead where the route narrows. And bring repair support through before rushing the next corner.

speaker: rook
text: Our vehicles are fast, not invincible. Hit exposed defenders together, break contact when armor starts failing, and make the scrap we recover count for something.

qc.heard: Our vehicles are fast, not invincible. Hit exposed defenders together, break contact when armor starts failing. And make the scrap we recover count for something.

speaker: rook
text: And try bringing your pathfinder back in one piece. Victory with at least half my hull earns a preservation commendation; the scrapyard remembers careful drivers.

qc.heard: And try bringing your Pathfinder back in one piece. Victory with at least half my hull earns a preservation commendation. The scrapyard remembers careful drivers.

speaker: rook
text: Everybody wants this crossing. Nobody asked the people living beside it. We are taking a route through the noise and getting our own people across alive.

qc.heard: Everybody wants this crossing. Nobody asked the people living beside it. We are taking a route through the noise and getting our own people across alive.

speaker: rook
text: Secure the marked objectives around the ford and keep the crossing open. Send infantry to control positions while the rigs cover their advance from firm ground.

qc.heard: Secure the marked objectives around the Ford and keep the crossing open. Send infantry to control positions while the rigs cover their advance from firm ground.

speaker: rook
text: Spread out after each narrow crossing. A clump of fast trucks is still one easy artillery target; repair the wounded vehicles before you spend another batch.

qc.heard: Spread out after each narrow crossing. A clump of fast trucks is still one easy artillery target. Repair the wounded vehicles before you spend another batch.

speaker: rook
text: We win by bringing people home, including me. Finish with my hull at half strength or better for the preservation commendation and another story around the fire.

qc.heard: We win by bringing people home, including me. Finish with my hull at half strength or better for the preservation commendation and another story around the fire.

speaker: rook
text: That scrapyard looks like a graveyard to them. To us it is spare armor, working engines, and enough parts to keep the outpost breathing another week.

qc.heard: That scrapyard looks like a graveyard to them. To us it is spare armor. Working engines and enough parts to keep the outpost breathing another week.

speaker: rook
text: Reach the marked salvage objectives and protect the crews working around them. Keep infantry near each control point, and use your vehicles to screen the open approaches.

qc.heard: Reach the marked salvage objectives and protect the crews working around them. Keep infantry near each control point and use your vehicles to screen the open approaches.

speaker: rook
text: Do not charge past valuable wrecks while your armor burns. Recover what the route allows, repair between fights, and keep enough mobile force to leave safely.

qc.heard: Do not charge past valuable wrecks while your armor burns. Recover what the route allows, repair between fights, and keep enough mobile force to leave safely.

speaker: rook
text: The best trophy is a crew that comes back. Victory with my hull at least half intact earns a preservation commendation for the outpost archive.

qc.heard: The best trophy is a crew that comes back. Victory with my hull at least half intact earns a preservation commendation for the outpost archive.

speaker: rook
text: Wren has a reason for keeping this channel open. I want to hear it before somebody stronger decides silence is simpler. We go in together this time.

qc.heard: Wren has a reason for keeping this channel open. I want to hear it before somebody stronger decides silence is simpler. We go in together this time.

speaker: rook
text: Follow the marked objectives and protect the people tied to the signal. Keep infantry ready for control points, and avoid outrunning your repair and escort support.

qc.heard: Follow the marked objectives and protect the people tied to the signal. Keep infantry ready for control points and avoid outrunning your repair and escort support.

speaker: rook
text: Use the rigs to cover movement, not to block every narrow street. Take the space you need, repair what you can, and leave a way back.

qc.heard: Use the rigs to cover movement, not to block every narrow street. Take the space you need, repair what you can, and leave a way back.

speaker: rook
text: I plan to hear the answer in person. Bring me through victory above half hull and claim the preservation commendation; we can argue about heroics afterward.

qc.heard: I plan to hear the answer in person. Bring me through victory above half hull and claim the preservation commendation. We can argue about heroics afterward.

speaker: rook
text: Dust Rangers, Iron Wardens, every patched engine in this canyon: this is what a coalition looks like. Nobody gets to decide our future without hearing us.

qc.heard: Dust Rangers, Iron Wardens, every patched engine in this canyon. This is what a coalition looks like. Nobody gets to decide our future without hearing us.

speaker: rook
text: Complete the marked final objectives while keeping the coalition force connected. Infantry secure the controls; armored rigs and repair crews keep their approach from closing behind them.

qc.heard: Complete the marked final objectives while keeping the coalition force connected. Infantry, secure the controls. Armored rigs and repair crews keep their approach from closing behind them.

speaker: rook
text: Our strength is replacement and recovery, not throwing everything away. Focus fire, clear room for damaged vehicles, and rebuild the line before the next push.

qc.heard: Our strength is replacement and recovery, not throwing everything away. Focus fire, clear room for damaged vehicles, and rebuild the line before the next push.

speaker: rook
text: Let us finish with a commander who can stand beside the others. Keep my hull at least half intact at victory for the final preservation commendation.

qc.heard: Let us finish with a commander who can stand beside the others. Keep my hull at least half intact at victory for the final preservation commendation.
